propositions: Close unconditionally invokes the completion provider via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the exact resolved close target SHA.

The signature verifier infrastructure can authenticate and extract the stored completion op-cert's SHA pin and material fingerprint, but the close seam never consults them before dispatching the provider.

A valid stored completion-verifier PASS whose authenticated SHA matches the resolved close ref and whose material fingerprint matches the ticket's current fingerprint must be reused, yielding zero provider calls.
Invalid, stale, changed-ref, reopened, FAIL, or cryptographically unverifiable completion attestations must fall through to fresh provider verification.
The reuse check must integrate into the shared close path (CLI, library, MCP) without weakening existing completion signing or durability.
Post-reopen attestations are invalidated and must trigger fresh verification.
